name: Istorija Flusha
source:
Do you want to feel like a superhero? This [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url] modification will give you this chance!

In this story, you will learn the story of an ordinary guy named Armen Barman, who, under unusual circumstances, gains strength and fights various types of evil.
The protagonist gathers a team of experienced heroes and unites their forces in order to defeat the villains in the fictional city of Under City.
translation:
你想感觉自己像个超级英雄吗？这个 [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url] 修改将为你提供这个机会！

在这个故事中，你将了解到一个名叫阿门·巴曼的普通人的故事，他在不寻常的情况下获得力量并与各种邪恶作斗争。
主角召集了一群经验丰富的英雄，并团结他们的力量，以击败虚构城市Under City中的恶棍。
